name: Theme Creator
description: Design your own Kanvaz color theme with live preview, save it as a named preset (rename, pin, star), and reset to Kanvaz's defaults anytime.
author: P4inz Interactive Labs

name: MCP Bridge
description: Lets Claude Desktop, Claude Code, or any other MCP-compatible AI tool read and edit your active board over a local-only connection. Off by default — every change it makes lands in undo history exactly like a manual edit.
author: P4inz Interactive Labs

name: Template Maker & Manager
description: Save any board as a reusable template, manage your own collection, browse/install templates other people made, and export/import a single template as a .kanvaztemplate file to hand to anyone else running a compatible Kanvaz.
author: P4inz Interactive Labs

name: AI Export
description: Export this board or the whole file as a JSON + Markdown pair any AI agent can read — no MCP connection, no server, nothing leaves this machine. Includes every card's tags, custom properties, and notes (Note-card text and Annotate-tool labels, merged).
author: P4inz Interactive Labs
